description.value: Time Out Cafe at City Hall is a café located inside Richmond City Hall, operated by BullMRKT & Truffles Fine Foods. It offers a wide-ranging menu of espresso drinks, breakfast items, sandwiches, salads, soups, pastries, and smoothies — a solid resupply stop for cyclists in central Richmond. Orders can be placed online for counter pickup.
